description: Retrieves a specific check item from a checklist using the checklist ID and check item ID.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving a specific check item from a checklist.

fields.description: Determines which fields to include in the response. Specify 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'name', 'nameData', 'pos', 'state', or 'type'.
fields.title: Fields

idCheckItem.description: The ID of the check item to retrieve.
idCheckItem.title: Id Check Item

idChecklist.description: The ID of the checklist containing the check item.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

inputSchema.title: GetCheckItemByIdRequest

name: get_check_item_by_id

GetCheckItemByIdResponse.description: Response schema for `GetChecklistsCheckItemsByIdChecklistByIdCheckItem`, containing the details of the retrieved check item.

due.description: ISO 8601 formatted due date for the check item (e.g., '2021-02-12T07:00:00.000Z'). Requires Business Class or higher subscription. Null if not set.
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: Reminder time in milliseconds before due date. Requires Business Class or higher subscription. Null if not set.
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: The unique identifier for the check item
id.title: Id

idChecklist.description: The ID of the parent checklist containing this check item
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: The ID of the member assigned to this check item. Requires Business Class or higher subscription. Null if not assigned.
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: The text/name of the check item
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional data associated with the name (typically null)
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: The position of the check item within the checklist
pos.title: Pos

state.description: The completion state of the check item. Possible values: 'complete' or 'incomplete'
state.title: State

GetCheckItemByIdResponse.title: GetCheckItemByIdResponse
